about_the_game:
Let the echoes of war guide your journey through Wartales!

Immerse yourself in the rugged beauty and harsh realities of a medieval world torn by conflict. This official soundtrack features 43 evocative tracks (MP3 & WAV files), capturing the tension of battle, the camaraderie of mercenaries, and the mystery of forgotten ruins.

For over 1 hour and 58 minutes, let these powerful compositions accompany you as you fight, explore, and carve your legend into the unforgiving lands of Wartales!
